correctness.rationale: With exactly the 30 two- and four-subsets of [6], distances are 0,2,4,6, giving exactly four Rips stages. Known Feng–Nukala Theorem 18 supplies degree-three wedge concentration at r=2, with Euler f-vector (30,210,520,480,132,20) yielding rank 29. Independently enumerated all 1392 faces and signed Lefschetz traces in each of the eleven S6 conjugacy classes and both complement cosets; the resulting character pair matches the package for all classes. Character orthogonality decomposes complement-even rank 15 as Specht (3,1,1,1)+(2,1,1,1,1) and complement-odd rank 14 as Specht (2,2,1,1)+(2,1,1,1,1). At r=4 the 15 complementary pairs form join (S0)^*15=S14, its S6 orientation character is +1 and complement acts -1. r>=6 is a simplex. Explicitly nonequivariant wedge result is borrowed, not independently new.

originality.rationale: Feng–Nukala already proves the nonequivariant wedge for these Boolean layers, so only the joint S6×C2 action is original. Briggs–Feng–Wells study full cubes and single ranks. Galetto–Montaño–Wellner 2026 computes full-cube hyperoctahedral homology, not the induced two-weight layer’s character; full-cube homology cannot be restricted to the subcomplex to obtain its homology. Its accessible abstract and overview were checked but full original was inaccessible, so substantial residual priority risk is recorded, not treated as automatic failure.
